newsitem.title: USA: Verio privately places $20 mln of preferred.
newsitem.headline: Verio privately places $20 mln of preferred.

text.p: Verio Inc said Tuesday it received $20 million in additional equity investments through issuance of convertible preferred stock to a group of the company's existing investors.
Verio said it intends to use the net proceeds from this offering to finance the company's continuing investments in Internet provider affiliates and its ongoing operations.

Verio has so far received about $100 million in private financing to build a national network that combines the strength of a high-speed backbone with the service of prominent local and regional Internet providers, it said.
The Verio group currently includes 19 Internet providers and will expand as the company completes additional acquisitions and investments throughout the year.
"Verio continues to meet its growth and operations objectives as the first national Internet provider that's local," said chief executive Justin Jaschke.

Members of the Verio group of Internet providers deliver secure, reliable connectivity and a full range of Internet applications to business customers, including Web hosting and co-location services, commerce and transaction services and security solutions.
